# Voice

## voice-28D68D0F

*Late-added unclear copy detracts from the overall graphic quality.*

## voice-4B8EA839

**SHOULD_NOT:** Avoid long, unstructured paragraphs in infographics.

*Dense unstructured text creates information overload and hurts scannability.*

Sources:
- https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/

## voice-DFF9ED85
